text_block_list.text:
Having cleared the 3rd match of the Aoharu 
Cup Preseason, not only was our team unity 
strong, but each member's abilities had 
been steadily growing.

However, there was one major problem. The 
team as a whole was losing its confidence.
The reason is likely—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
We are starting running drills. Be in 
position within 30 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Team <First>
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The basics are literally your foundation. 
Be thorough and deliberate, and stay 
conscious of what part of your body you 
are training.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Haaah, wheeze, haaah!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
1,000 meters remaining! Your pace is 
dropping, pick up the tempo from here!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Don't lose form! Keep center of gravity in 
mind! Faster! Even faster!!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Kh...! Yes, ma'am!!

Even to an outsider, Acting Principal 
Kashimoto's training was so intense that 
there wasn't even room for idle chatter—

And the members of Team First were 
fighting desperately to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that's amazing...! They're trying so 
hard!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Can we really win... against a team trying 
that hard...?

The sight of Team <First>'s training sessions was 
intense in many ways, leaving more than a 
few Umamusume utterly overwhelmed...

"Even so, I've been training hard, too. I 
should be able to put up a decent fight 
now."
choice_data_list:
(I want to help her gain confidence before 
the real thing!)

text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: A practice match with your team, is it?
choice_data_list: This should make for great training!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...Though it was unofficial, I have raced 
against your team once before."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It is a wonderful opportunity to directly 
feel each other's growth. Understood, I 
accept.

Afterward, once we discussed the details 
and Acting Director Kashimoto left—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I happened to overhear! Not since 
our street race, huh!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a scrimmage, huh? Do you remember 
what happened last time?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"They're just folks who chose the easy way 
over getting stronger. Even if they grew a 
bit, it amounts to next to nothin'."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, please don't mind her harsh 
words.

Putting their harsh words aside... seeing 
how they undergo training stricter than 
anyone else's,

It's understandable to feel irritated 
seeing everyone around you training so 
happily together. Even so—
choice_data_list: You're fine with being managed like that?
Are you okay with being managed like that?

text_block_list.text:
It seemed strange to her that so many 
Umamusume at the academy hated it and 
resisted so desperately.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. As long as I get stronger, that's 
fine, right? Even if it's not fun, it 
doesn't bother me at all.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Kashimoto speaks bluntly, but she 
helps us grow properly. I trust her."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I completely agree!

I had a feeling from watching them train, 
but— the members of Team First seem to 
really look up to Acting Director 
Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"A p-p-p-practice match with T-T-T-Team 
First!?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
B-But goodness me, I vividly remember 
having absolutely no chance against her 
just the other day...!

I told her that she's bound to have a 
great race right now, and that I want her 
to be confident heading into the main 
event.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...YES! I think so too! We make a very 
good team!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! In that case, I'll do my absolute 
best, knowing I'm in safe hands with 
everyone aboard!

And so, we spent our days buried in 
training in preparation for the upcoming 
practice match—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Rice! Your pace is dropping! Go, go, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
278, 279, 280! Rice-chan! Just a little 
bit more!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? Which rep was that again?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh, wait, huh...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What should I do? If I get 
totally crushed out there...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, you know... Rice isn't very confident 
either...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! You too, Rice-san~? That somehow 
makes me so happy~."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I know! Would you like to do a little 
confidence-boosting charm together with 
me?
And—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haaaah...――!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "*pant, pant*! Yay, it's a new record...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... well... Training has just been 
so much fun lately.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's trying their best, so... Rice 
is gonna do her best too...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

"By cooperating, supporting each other, 
and sometimes competing, the team's 
abilities grew by leaps and bounds!"
